title: Battle fixes and PC helpers
notes: Suggested items: the new ITEMS button next to AUTO under your party gives your team the held items from your Bag that suit each one. You see the swaps first; it never takes an item from another Pokémon.
Drag a whole box: in the PC’s Boxes list, drag a box onto another to move it there with all its Pokémon.
Pokédex: Registered and Seen now filter the Pokédex, and Looks shows which Shiny, Void and Prismatic looks of each species you’ve registered.
changes: Sending to the Professor (Send duplicates and Select → Send) lists what goes with each one’s nature and IVs, best IVs first.
Selecting several Pokémon in the PC: the card on the right shows the last one you picked.
The badge screen closes by itself after 8 seconds (or when you click), so the hunt never waits. Fly there / Stay still decides what happens.
In battle, a wild Pokémon’s look is written next to its IVs, and the row of looks under it is labelled “In your PC”. Moves show their priority.
fixes: Heavy Slam and Heat Crash now hit by weight (heavier user, more power) instead of 1–2 damage.
Fire Spin, Wrap, Whirlpool, sandstorm, burn and poison no longer hurt anyone after the battle is already won or lost. A trap also ends when the Pokémon that set it leaves.
Whirlpool, Fire Spin, Wrap, Bind, Sand Tomb, Infestation, Magma Storm and Thunder Cage have their move descriptions.

title: Small fixes
changes: Battles end after 10 turns in which neither side can land a hit: a wild Pokémon flees (no loss, the hunt goes on); Gyms and the Tower count it as out of turns.
Rare Candy says why it stops at your level cap, and which Gym raises it.
Your save now keeps hourly and daily backups (Settings → Help → Backups).
Progress is always saved before an update.
The game always stays on screen; tray menu → Reset position.
fixes: The egg hatch screens no longer stop you from using or closing your other windows while they are open.
Party cards no longer stretch tall.

title: Megas, breeding and terrains
notes: Mega Evolution info: a "Mega" chip with its stone on the Pokémon card, the Hunt cards and in the PC (filter: Can Mega Evolve). Pokémon whose evolution can Mega Evolve say which one.
Day Care: both parents’ IVs side by side (green = higher than the other parent), and right-click a parent to open its full card.
Ditto knows Transform, and a Ditto with Imposter copies the foe the moment it comes in.
Terrains: Electric, Grassy, Psychic and Misty Surge (and Hadron Engine, Quark Drive, Seed Sower, Surge Surfer) now work in every battle except raids.

Catch rules: a Never send list of species (every copy stays), Living dex (your best one of each species stops evolving on its own) and Use evolution items (stones in your Bag are used by themselves). All off until you turn them on.
A Shiny, Void or Prismatic nanny hatches eggs a little faster (10%, 15%, 20%).
changes: Guarded now works like Sturdy: your Pokémon hangs on at 1 HP and still gets its move that turn.
Giant bosses that have no Gigantamax form are now called Dynamax; the Gigantamax look is for the real ones.
A Pokémon cries when you open its card. Natures show on the stats: the raised one green, the lowered one red.
PC filters: Evolves into a new Pokédex entry, Can still evolve, Fully evolved, Can Mega Evolve.
Move Tutor: show only Physical, Special or Status moves, or sort by them.
The big-spend question has a "Don’t show again" box (the bell next to your money in the Mart brings it back).
Your panel layout and monitor settings now stay put through updates.
Catch rules: Auto-evolve can be switched off. Pokémon then wait as Ready to evolve until you press Evolve.
Night Market: change your price without taking the listing down.
fixes: When your last Pokémon and the foe faint on the same turn, the game now says so and your team rests at the Pokémon Center.
The Blue and Pink Wonder Card backgrounds had each other’s names.
The login card now shows the steps when Discord says your email isn’t verified.
Your Founder badge now shows on your own Trainer card too.
Players with lots of friends no longer drop offline.
Send all gifts now reaches every friend and tells you how many went out.
Thanks to dll5700 and iwrecked22 for the ideas, and to everyone who reported bugs in the Discord!
